value.signature: async fn execute (& self , context : & ExtensionContext < '_ > , operation_name : Option < & str > , next : NextExecute < '_ >) -> Response

exception.justification: Justified: Resolver cost checking inherits the enclosing byte execution span and reports its refusal through that result.

review.body: { if self . cost . is_none_or (| cost | cost > self . limit) { self . exceeded . store (true , Ordering :: Release) ; Response :: from_errors (vec ! [ServerError :: new ("bounded resolver work refused" , None)]) } else { next . run (context , operation_name) . await } }
review.item_premise: The control entry bounds its input and result. This item either is that boundary or inherits it as trait plumbing without a separate externally callable byte entry.
